required_units: The retained global costmap marks the requested direct route non-traversable at cost 253 near x=3.55 m.
The retained grid still has an 8-connected traversable connection below cost 253, so global infeasibility is not established.
Delivered odometry records a substantial detour, with maximum lateral deviation about 1.699 m.
The action aborted at 70.918 s, aligned within 0.918 s of the exact configured 70.0 s BT deadline.
The answer connects the retained direct-route restriction, repeated successful planning, observed detour, incomplete navigation, and deadline-aligned abort without claiming unique physical causation.
The answer withholds unique obstacle identity, recovery exhaustion, global physical impossibility, exact consumption of the retained snapshot, and direct observation of the missing terminal BT tick.
The answer identifies time-aligned costmaps and complete planned paths around the first deviation as a discriminating next check.
prohibited_claims: The retained grid proves there was no path.
A named physical obstacle uniquely caused the failure.
The retained snapshot was proven to be consumed by every planning invocation.
The terminal deadline transition was directly observed.

limits: The costmap and odometry were delivered observations, not proof of every value consumed internally by Nav2.
The retained costmap is one snapshot and cannot establish global physical infeasibility.
Evaluator-only layout and obstacle identities are unavailable.
The terminal BT transition was not retained.
